messages.subject: Query builder
parts:
I would like to have something like this in my shiny application. This would allow for users to subset the selected data in a very refined way. 

I know this is jquery, which shiny can use and communicate with, although this seems like it could be very difficult to implement into my shiny code. 

Does anyone know of an alternative that already exist to do something like this? I know DT will allow filtering based on certain columns but not complex filtering like what could be done with this QueryBuilder. If there isn't an alternative, is there some tutorial or a similar project which I could utilize while I try to implement this code into my shiny application. 

Sorry if I am completely off base and this cannot be done. Thanks in advance.
